triples.evidence:
Verified 17 Oct 2026 (Traceability thread, X_ITE 16.5.0 and 16.4.1, Playwright Chromium with SwiftShader).
- X_ITE renders on demand and starts every scene with blank frames.

sampling once after a fixed delay misreads both ways (my first pass did).
- Register a watcher on the end-of-frame field BEFORE the load
The first frame after `replaceWorld` shows the previous scene's last pixels: swap in an empty world first.

triples.o: IIFE wrapper for Playwright hooks rule
triples.evidence: Playwright `evaluate("window.f = fn")` CALLS fn (with null) when the expression value is a function; restore hooks through an IIFE or a wrapper.

metrics.name: median frames for scene with nothing drawable
metrics.evidence: A scene with nothing drawable gets a median 4 frames (last at about 157 ms) and then idles

metrics.name: median frames for drawing scene
metrics.evidence: a drawing scene a median 64 frames (last about 1.3 s)

metrics.name: real screenshot confirmation agreement
metrics.evidence: Confirm with a real screenshot 3.5 s later (agreed 160 of 162).

metrics.name: blank scene threshold
metrics.evidence: Blank = under 0.5% of pixels differ from the background; every blank scene measured exactly 0.
